functionalRequirement: System shall show the first lines of news articles based on the titles on the title screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load and display article previews within 2 seconds for up to 20 concurrent news titles.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick loading of article previews is crucial for user engagement and information accessibility.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide a consistent and readable preview format with truncated text that maintains readability and context.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensuring clear and concise article previews enhances user understanding and interaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The system must support fetching article previews from multiple news sources with standardized data formats.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables flexible integration with various news content providers and APIs.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement multi-factor authentication with at least two verification methods (password + SMS or email verification).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures secure account creation and prevents unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Enforce password complexity requirements including minimum 12 characters, mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects user accounts from weak password vulnerabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide real-time validation for all input fields with clear, immediate error messages for incorrect data formats.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users correct input errors during account creation process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.9% uptime for account creation and verification processes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can create accounts consistently without service interruptions.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to import and manage various data formats like images, videos, and audio files within presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: Support importing and processing media files up to 2GB in size with memory usage not exceeding 500MB per file.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures efficient handling of large media files in presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Support at least 10 common media file formats including JPEG, PNG, MP4, AVI, MP3, WAV, and provide clear error handling for unsupported formats.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables flexible media import across different file types and sources.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: Provide a drag-and-drop interface for media file import with preview capabilities for all supported file types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Simplifies the process of adding media to presentations for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: Design media import and management as a pluggable module with clear separation of concerns for different file type handlers.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows easy extension of file format support and future improvements.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to set the price, quantity, upload pictures, and add details when listing an item.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement server-side validation to prevent price manipulation and ensure listed prices are within predefined reasonable ranges.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects against fraudulent or incorrect pricing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide real-time input validation with clear guidance for price, quantity, and required details fields.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users correctly input item listing information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Complete item listing process, including image upload, within 5 seconds for files up to 10MB.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures a smooth and responsive item listing experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: Allow dynamic addition of custom fields for item details beyond standard attributes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides flexibility for different types of item listings.

functionalRequirement: Doctors shall be able to log in to check patient information, answer patient queries, perform daily activities, set reminders, and communicate with their staff.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Encrypt all patient information using AES-256 encryption, both at rest and in transit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive patient data from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.99% uptime for the medical communication and information system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for continuous patient care and medical operations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Provide context-sensitive help and quick access to user guides within the system interface.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supports doctors in efficiently using the system's features.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement role-based access control with multi-factor authentication and automatic session timeout after 30 minutes of inactivity.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures secure access and protects patient information.
